name: 27-sell-markup-sl-at-account-ask
why: Owner decision 2026-09-26, revised to SYMMETRIC MARKUP 2026-10-29: a SELL closes (and its SL triggers) at the account's ask, which now carries HALF the markup. BrokerSymbol.spreadMarkup 1.5 pips on XAUUSD = 0.15 split: raw ask 4299.13 is below the SL 4299.20, the account ask ceil(4299.13 + 0.075) = 4299.21 is above it, so the SL fires and closes at 4299.21 (-921). Needs scripts/parity/run-ts.ts to seed BrokerSymbol.spreadMarkup from symbols[].spreadMarkup.
